messages:
emma: opened PR #4982 with a new section: 'bootstrap bundle fetch' for semi-airgapped private installs. aims to cover: one-shot outbound fetch for certs, curl fallback for restricted sites, checksum verification, and a small systemd service example. preview: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4982

ci-bot: CI: docs build passed  preview: https://deploy-preview.internal.redwood/4982 (build 9182)

noah: quick skim looks good. request: show both `scp` + `curl` examples. for curl show `--retry 5 --fail --connect-timeout 10` and `--tlsv1.2` enforced. some customers block non-TLS egress.

emma: yup adding both. also adding `sha256sum` verification example and a short blurb about where to store the checksum file in the bundle.

ria: small KMS/HSM note: call out that PKCS11 socket paths differ by vendor. examples: `/var/run/pkcs11/softHSM.sock`, `/opt/hsm/pkcs11.sock`. say 'check appliance docs for the expected socket path' to avoid confusion.

lee: minor nit: checklist item 3 links to `#seed-bootstrap` but anchor on the page is `#bootstrap-seed`. I'll push the anchor fix in a follow-up commit unless you want it here.

emma: please push it to this branch if convenient, saves an extra PR. also debating whether to include `REDWOOD_SEED_MODE=bootstrap-only` env var example; is that the right var?

noah: var is `REDWOOD_SEED_MODE=seed-only` (we used this in a customer deploy). add a sentence: "set to seed-only to prevent model-registry fetch during bootstrap".

ria: include a very short troubleshooting item: "If bundle fetch fails intermittently, check MTU on overlay/VPN (we saw drops at 1400 bytes)." this avoids long back-and-forth in support.

emma: added the troubleshooting tip and the PKCS11 note. also added a tiny systemd unit snippet for `seed-fetch.service` and a one-line `ExecStartPre` to verify checksum: `sha256sum -c /opt/seed/bundle.sha256 || exit 1`.

docs-bot: Docs reminder: PR #4982 not labeled `needs-legal`. Does this contain encryption material that requires review?

emma: the PR just documents secure handling steps for cert bundles and includes no export-sensitive content. i'll ping legal for a quick ack and add a short line: "treat cert bundles as secrets; rotate and delete after bootstrap."

ci-bot: CI: preview updated  https://deploy-preview.internal.redwood/4982?update=2 (build 9184)

lee: approved after anchor fix and small wording tweak on the checksum section. :white_check_mark:

noah: LGTM once legal gives a thumbs-up. nice concise examples.

emma: thanks all  plan: merge after legal ack and green CI. ETA today PST.
